title: Check a deploy
prompt: Check a deployment and tell me whether it is healthy. Ask which environment and release to check, and which evidence should count as success.

title: Watch a pull request
prompt:
Help me set up a fleet to review GitHub pull requests.

Ask me which repositories it should review, when it should run, and where I want its findings. Do not assume a repository or destination.

Review the exact pull request I provide and its current head. Read the relevant diff, source, tests, and check results. Report concrete correctness, security, and regression risks with file/line or check evidence. A clean review is a valid result; do not invent findings.

Keep the work unfinished when required evidence is missing or a required check is pending, and explain the next useful action.

Comment only. Do not push code, approve, merge, close, or deploy.

Propose these completion questions for me to review and edit:

1. Does the review cover the requested pull request at its current head?
   Yes: the relevant diff and source were inspected at that head, with the agreed checks accounted for.
   No: the target or head differs, or required review evidence is missing or incomplete.

2. Are the findings supported by concrete code or check evidence?
   Yes: each finding has supporting evidence, or the review clearly reports no confirmed findings.
   No: findings are speculative, contradictory, unsupported, or based on stale evidence.

Keep my wording when I edit these questions or their yes/no criteria. Work through the setup with me before I save the fleet.

title: Create a plugin
prompt: Help me create a reusable fleet setup that I can save as a plugin. Ask what work it should do and what access it needs.
